model: WF45R6100AW (white; the family also sells AP platinum and AC champagne)
notes: Samsung 4.5 cu ft front loader in white. The spec sheet lists a direct-drive motor, an internal water heater and a stainless steel drum; the resistances come from the service manual for the WF45R6100 series, which lists WF45R6100AW among its models. The manual's heater check gives separate values for 1900 W and 2000 W versions, so measure the heater before assuming which one this unit has.

gaps: The spec sheet says Direct Drive Motor; the words 'Digital Inverter' appear in neither source, so that name is not claimed.
The service manual is for the WF45R6100AP/US basic model (also written WF6000R); its cover lists WF45R6100AW/US among the model codes. No AW-only wording was found.

The heater values are given for a 1900 W product (27.1 ohm) and a 2000 W product (26.2 ohm); the manual does not say which one is the AW, so no heater wattage is set on the part, and the heater is not marked AC because the page gives no voltage.
Page 35 (touch module connectors) was dropped as the controller source; the main PCB connector list on page 34 is used instead.
The drain pump, inlet valves and door lock switch have no resistance or voltage on the pages read; no chip, board or power-module part numbers are printed in them, so no datasheet links are given.
Years: no production year is given in either source; the manual is copyright 2018 and the spec sheet 2019.
The spec sheet is for the platinum AP; the white AW appears in its colour table with its own model number and UPC.
method: Samsung WF45R6100AP spec sheet (Samsung US front-load washer sheet, copyright 2019; the colour table includes WF45R6100AW), read as a PDF.
ManualsLib: Samsung WF45R6100AP/US service manual, 38 pages, copyright 2018 (manual 3313659). Viewer pages read: 1 (cover, model list), 13, 20, 22, 23, 25, 26, 29 and 34.
The resistance values on pages 13 and 25 were read in two separate fetches of the page text; page images were not checked.
No bot check, login or paywall met on ManualsLib. Sears PartsDirect and PartSelect were not used.

comps.spec: Direct Drive Motor (feature list), with a ten-year part warranty on the direct drive motor. Maximum spin 1200 RPM.

comps.loc: At the rear, reached by removing the back cover
comps.spec: Rear motor stator with three motor wires (blue, white, red); 15 ohm between blue-white, white-red and red-blue (p. 13). Six M10 screws separate it from the motor bracket assembly.
Rear motor rotor, taken off after the M19 nut and washer are removed; the manual warns that its magnetic force is strong and it can come off suddenly (p. 13).
Wash heater: the check point in the manual gives 27.1 ohm for its 1900 W product and 26.2 ohm for its 2000 W product (p. 25). The spec sheet lists an internal water heater.
Thermistor: the check point on the heater page gives 12 kohm at room temperature (p. 25).
Pump motor assembly (ASSY PUMP), held on by two screws (Disassembling the Pump Motor Part, p. 22).
Water valves: the test modes list separate operation tests for the cold, hot and water shot valves (p. 29).
Door lock switch (DOOR LOCK SW), reached when the front frame is taken apart; three screws hold it (Disassembling the Frame Front, p. 20).
Water level sensor (error code 1C), read through a hose; a punctured hose where the sensor sits is a listed cause (Error Modes, p. 26).

Main PCB assembly (ASSY MAIN PCB): its connector pinouts list motor phases U, V and W, cold, hot, rinse and bleach valve outputs, the drain pump, door lock and unlock, and water level and water temperature signals (circuit diagrams section, viewer page 34).
Stainless steel drum, with a three-year part warranty (spec sheet).
Tub suspension parts named in the tub disassembly: a damper (4 bolts), a spring-hanger and a weight balancer (6 bolts) (p. 23).
